ui.help: Click or tap the floor to walk. Click or tap a person or object to open the action ring, then choose an action. Click an item in the satchel to look at it or use it on something. Hold Space (or press the eye button, or press and hold on a touch screen) to see everything you can interact with. With the keyboard, Tab moves between things in the room and Enter opens the action ring. Right-click or Esc cancels. Click to skip a line.

ui.endText: Behind him, Cinderfold is cold for the first time in Mara's life. In his satchel, the regulator pulses against his hip, slow and steady, like something waiting for an answer.

intro.1: Beyond the walls the land is ash and wind. Little grows there, and the roads are long and empty.
intro.2: Still, here and there, people hold on: around a fire, a well, a machine that still works. They patch what breaks, and they keep each other going.
intro.3: Cinderfold is one of those places: a village built inside an old kiln, warm for as long as its fire burns.
intro.4: Mara keeps its valves and carries its errands. This morning starts like any other.
